acceptance_criteria.text: Formal activity UI opens authored activities without manufacturing mastery success; actual response evaluation remains CourseProgress authority.
Package to modern runtime mapping preserves authored mastery, assessments, lecture content/interactions, academic semantics, and Lab identity/effects without default replacement when fields exist.
Canonical schema and TypeScript validator strictly agree on nested contract surfaces, including instructor modes, assets, migrations, academic, lectures, Labs, and extensionMetadata.
Platform learner envelope is the canonical writable progress authority and package identity survives install/update/remove, migration, and encrypted backup roundtrip.
Public built-in packages remain conservative and private package content remains outside public source and history.
